create_skill: create a new LiteLLM skill in the database with a display title, description, and instructions
list_skills: list LiteLLM skills from the database with pagination support using limit and offset
get_skill: get a LiteLLM skill by its ID from the database, raising an error if not found
delete_skill: delete a LiteLLM skill from the database by its ID, raising an error if not found
fetch_skill_from_db: fetch a LiteLLM skill from the database by ID, returning None if not found
